subject.title: fix(slack): time out stalled external file uploads

question: Should OpenClaw expose PlatformMessageNotDispatchedError as a public plugin SDK contract that lets channel adapters assert a failed send is safe for durable replay?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and documented, but it delegates duplicate-delivery safety to external plugin code and creates a lasting compatibility and trust contract that automation cannot accept for maintainers.

options.title: Accept narrow public contract
options.body: Keep the class public only for adapter-owned failures before any recipient-visible or finalization-capable operation, with the documented conservative rules.

options.title: Keep replay authority internal
options.body: Remove the plugin SDK export and retain a Slack/core-private signal until maintainers design a broader replay contract.

recommendation.title: Accept narrow public contract
recommendation.body: Keep the class public only for adapter-owned failures before any recipient-visible or finalization-capable operation, with the documented conservative rules.
